caption: The drawing displays three intricately designed objects on a plain light beige background. At the upper part of the image, there is a side view of an ornamental wall shelf or bracket rendered in brown tones, decorated with geometric and floral patterns and featuring a spiral design in the middle right section. Below, there is a circular object, perhaps a cover or decorative wheel, in similar brown hues, adorned with a symmetrical floral motif comprising repeated petal-like elements radiating from the center and enclosed within a patterned ring. To the right and slightly above the circular object, there is a smaller, lightly sketched depiction of the wall bracket in black and white, which includes an oil lamp sitting atop the shelf. The drawing is signed in the bottom right corner with “M. ARIE FAMULARO” and dated “9-1-1908.”
title: Lamp Bracket
